rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing number of petals
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining form and attributes of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject.
It is described as a king among cakras.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is characterized as a royal center with eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific symbolic meaning of the epithet rājānam in this context is not explicit.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the kingly one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
